name: jarvis-dual-agent-assistant
description: Voice-first dual-agent desktop assistant with ChatGPT and Codex orchestration.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @jarvis/core && npm run build -w @jarvis/voice && npm run build -w @jarvis/agents && npm run build -w @jarvis/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jarvis/core && npm run test -w @jarvis/voice && npm run test -w @jarvis/agents && npm run test -w @jarvis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/core && npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/voice && npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/agents && npm run typecheck -w @jarvis/desktop
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jarvis/core && npm run build -w @jarvis/voice && npm run build -w @jarvis/agents && npm run dev -w @jarvis/desktop
